verdict.rationale: YYLO documents its own `yy continue SESSION_ID` command for continuing a captured agent session, and workflow steps can consume a session from an earlier step, so work can carry on without starting over. The evidence only shows resuming a captured session, not injecting follow-up instructions into a live, running agent mid-task. Missing for 10: documented mid-run steering of an active session, explicit syntax for supplying follow-up instructions, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: Continue a captured session with `yy continue SESSION_ID`; do not reconstruct work from tmux scrollback.
Choose Workflow Runner when a step consumes `{{ steps.<id>.response }}`, a generated file, or a session from an earlier step.
